description: Variation of conditions 2, 5, 6, 7 and 8 to ref: 25/02666/FUL to allow changes to boundary between 24 and 24A Turkey Street.
decision_conditions: By reason of the proposed amendment to the approved plans, which would alter the red line boundary and materially change the extent of the application site and associated planning unit, the proposal falls outside the scope of a Section 73 application. The proposed changes would result in a reduction in the usability of the garden area, a material planning consideration. As such, the proposal cannot be lawfully considered under Section 73 and is contrary to the objectives of achieving high-quality residential environments as set out in Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3 and D6 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD6, DMD8 and DMD9 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
